SHAPES · 20 COLORING PAGES · AGES 2–4

Shapes coloring pages — circles, squares, triangles and friends.

Twenty coloring pages from the owner’s own bold, friendly artwork: one clear outline per page, with the real-world twin beside it — a circle and a beach ball, a rectangle and a bus, a triangle and a house. Download and print buttons sit right under every picture.

Circle Coloring PageAge 2+ShapesOne big circle, ready for its first crayon. Two Circles Coloring PageAge 2+ShapesTwo circles — one up high, one down low. Circle & Beach Ball Coloring PageAge 2+ShapesA plain circle and a beach ball — the circle went to the seaside! Square Coloring PageAge 2+ShapesOne big square with four straight sides. Pillow & Square Coloring PageAge 2+ShapesA comfy pillow and a plain square — squares are soft too! Square & Gift Box Coloring PageAge 2+ShapesA plain square and a present with a bow — which one would you open? Triangle Coloring PageAge 2+ShapesOne big triangle with three pointy corners. Tall Triangle Coloring PageAge 2+ShapesA stretched-up triangle — taller than it is wide. Triangle & House Coloring PageAge 2+ShapesA pointy-down triangle and a triangle roof — triangles build houses! Sandwich & Mountain Coloring PageAge 2+ShapesA sandwich wedge and a two-peak mountain — triangles you can eat and climb! Rectangle Coloring PageAge 2+ShapesOne big rectangle — two long sides, two short sides. Tall Rectangle Coloring PageAge 2+ShapesA stretched-up rectangle — like a tower! Rectangle & Bus Coloring PageAge 2+ShapesA plain rectangle and a bus — the rectangle grew wheels! Oval Coloring PageAge 2+ShapesA stretched-out circle — an oval! Two Ovals Coloring PageAge 2+ShapesTwo oval rings — one standing tall, one lying flat. Egg Shape Coloring PageAge 2+ShapesOne big egg — an oval with a secret: which end is up? Star Coloring PageAge 2+ShapesOne big five-point star, ready to shine. Heart Coloring PageAge 2+ShapesOne big heart — color it for someone you love. Apple & Banana Coloring PageAge 2+ShapesAn apple with its leaf and a big curved banana — snack-time shapes. Book & Phone Coloring PageAge 2+ShapesA book and a phone — rectangles you already love.
COLOR ON SCREEN TOO

Every page has an on-screen twin.

Each of these twenty pictures can be colored right here on the website in Class 9 — Colors and Shapes (Age 2): the drawing layer sits on the picture, little hands use a finger, a stylus or the mouse, and every child’s colors are saved for next time. Open the class and start with the big circle.

COLORING PAGE · SHAPES · AGE 2+

Circle Coloring Page

A printable circle coloring page for 2-year-olds: one big bold circle to color, trace and talk about — on paper or on screen with finger, stylus or mouse.

Teaching tips
THE COLORING PAGE

The full picture, exactly as the artist drew it.

See the whole picture, download the original file or print it clean — just the picture, no buttons or banners. Want to color it right now on this screen? Start coloring online — same picture, drawing layer included.

HOW TO USE IT

Three little steps.

  1. 1

    Color it

    Color the big circle. Staying inside the line is a bonus, not a rule.

  2. 2

    Trace it

    Trace around the circle line with your finger — round and round.

  3. 3

    Find one

    Find a circle near you — a plate, a cup, a wheel — and say “circle!”

COLORING PAGE · SHAPES · AGE 2+

Two Circles Coloring Page

A printable two-circles coloring page for toddlers: one circle up high and one down low to color, count and compare — on paper or on screen.

Teaching tips
THE COLORING PAGE

The full picture, exactly as the artist drew it.

HOW TO USE IT

Three little steps.

  1. 1

    Count them

    Point and count: one circle… two circles!

  2. 2

    Color them

    Give each circle a color — the same or different, your toddler decides.

  3. 3

    Find them

    Find two round things at home and count them too.

COLORING PAGE · SHAPES · AGE 2+

Circle & Beach Ball Coloring Page

A printable beach-ball coloring page for 2-year-olds: a plain circle beside a segmented beach ball to color, compare and name — on paper or on screen.

Teaching tips
THE COLORING PAGE

The full picture, exactly as the artist drew it.

HOW TO USE IT

Three little steps.

  1. 1

    Compare

    One circle is plain and one is a beach ball — point to each one.

  2. 2

    Color the ball

    Color every slice of the beach ball a different color.

  3. 3

    Bounce

    Done coloring? Bounce like a ball three times!

Square Coloring Page

A printable square coloring page for 2-year-olds: one big bold square to color, trace and find at home — on paper or on screen.

Teaching tips
THE COLORING PAGE

The full picture, exactly as the artist drew it.

Three little steps.

  1. 1

COLORING PAGE · SHAPES · AGE 2+

Pillow & Square Coloring Page

A printable pillow-and-square coloring page for toddlers: a soft pillow shape beside a plain square to color and compare — on paper or on screen.

Teaching tips
THE COLORING PAGE

The full picture, exactly as the artist drew it.

HOW TO USE IT

Three little steps.

  1. 1

    Compare

    A pillow and a square — how are they the same? How are they different?

  2. 2

    Color both

    Color the pillow and the square — maybe the same color, maybe not.

  3. 3

    Find one

    Find a real pillow and pat its soft corners.

Square & Gift Box Coloring Page

A printable gift-box coloring page for 2-year-olds: a plain square beside a gift box with a bow to color, compare and chatter about — on paper or on screen.

Teaching tips
THE COLORING PAGE

The full picture, exactly as the artist drew it.

HOW TO USE IT

Three little steps.

  1. 1

    Compare

    Point to the plain square, then to the gift box.

  2. 2

    Color the present

    Color the box and the bow — birthday colors!

  3. 3

    Pretend

    Wrap it up: who is the present for? Say it out loud.

Triangle Coloring Page

A printable triangle coloring page for 2-year-olds: one big bold triangle to color, trace and find — on paper or on screen.

Teaching tips
THE COLORING PAGE

The full picture, exactly as the artist drew it.

HOW TO USE IT

Three little steps.

  1. 1

    Color it

    Color the whole triangle in one go — big arm moves!

  2. 2

    Count corners

    Touch each pointy corner and count: one, two, three!

  3. 3

    Find one

    Find a triangle at home — a slice of pizza, a roof, a ramp.

Tall Triangle Coloring Page

A printable tall-triangle coloring page for toddlers: a long, stretched triangle to color and compare with a regular one — on paper or on screen.

Teaching tips
THE COLORING PAGE

The full picture, exactly as the artist drew it.

HOW TO USE IT

Three little steps.

  1. 1

    Reach up

    This triangle is TALL — reach your hands up high like its point.

  2. 2

    Color it

    Color from the top point all the way down to the bottom.

  3. 3

    Compare

    Remember the first triangle? This one is stretched tall!

Triangle & House Coloring Page

A printable triangle coloring page for 2-year-olds: an upside-down triangle shape and a little house with a triangle roof to color and talk about.

Teaching tips
THE COLORING PAGE

The full picture, exactly as the artist drew it.

HOW TO USE IT

Three little steps.

  1. 1

    Spot them

    One triangle points DOWN, and one sits on the house as a roof.

  2. 2

    Color the house

    Color the roof and the walls — what color is your house?

  3. 3

    Color the top shape

    The pointy-down shape looks like a slice of pizza — yum!

Sandwich & Mountain Coloring Page

A printable sandwich-and-mountain coloring page for toddlers: a sandwich wedge and a pointy mountain, both built from triangles — on paper or on screen.

Teaching tips
THE COLORING PAGE

The full picture, exactly as the artist drew it.

Three little steps.

  3. 3

    Color the mountain

    Color the mountain brown or gray — or rainbow, if you like.

Three little steps.

Rectangle & Bus Coloring Page

A printable bus coloring page for 2-year-olds: a plain rectangle beside a bus body with two round wheels to color and compare — on paper or on screen.

Teaching tips
THE COLORING PAGE

The full picture, exactly as the artist drew it.

HOW TO USE IT

Three little steps.

  1. 1

    Compare

    One shape is plain; one is a BUS. Wheels are circles!

  2. 2

    Color the bus

Oval Coloring Page

A printable oval coloring page for 2-year-olds: one big oval to color, trace and compare with a circle — on paper or on screen.

Teaching tips
THE COLORING PAGE

The full picture, exactly as the artist drew it.

HOW TO USE IT

Three little steps.

  1. 1

    Color it

    Color the oval with slow, gentle strokes — it is a squished circle.

  2. 2

    Trace it

    Trace all the way around — it goes on and on, no corners!

  3. 3

    Find one

Two Ovals Coloring Page

Teaching tips
THE COLORING PAGE

The full picture, exactly as the artist drew it.

HOW TO USE IT

Three little steps.

  1. 1

    Compare

    One oval stands UP and one lies DOWN — point to each.

  2. 2

    Color the rings

    Color the flat ring like a plate and the tall one like a balloon.

  3. 3

Egg Shape Coloring Page

A printable egg coloring page for 2-year-olds: one big egg outline to color, decorate and talk about — on paper or on screen.

Teaching tips
THE COLORING PAGE

The full picture, exactly as the artist drew it.

HOW TO USE IT

Three little steps.

  1. 1

    Spot it

    It looks like an oval… but one end is smaller. It is an EGG!

  2. 2

    Color it

    Color the egg — speckles welcome.

The full picture, exactly as the artist drew it.

Teaching tips
THE COLORING PAGE

The full picture, exactly as the artist drew it.

Three little steps.
